mara: quick heads-up — ran kv-cache bench across EU-H100 and US-A100 for the new int8 bring-up. spotted an odd quality/latency pattern for long sequences (>=1024). p99 in EU-H100 jumped ~25% compared to fp16, hitrate dropped ~8% for slen>=1024. link to dashboard: https://internal.redwood/perf/2123 :eyes:

sanjay: can you paste the bench config? was this with default prefetch + LRU eviction?

mara: yeah default: prefetch=1024, eviction=LRU, batcher=continuous, quant=int8. command: `bench run --model rwd-v2 --quant int8 --slen-buckets 8,64,256,1024,4096 --gpu h100 --region eu`

lee: @mara thanks. two quick thoughts: (1) kernel-selection on H100 may pick a different matmul path for int8 that increases per-token CPU work and stalls kv refill; (2) EU cluster has slightly higher paging churn due to co-tenancy on some nodes — increases host<->device transfer contention. do you have kernel logs? run: `rctl logs kernel-selection --run 2123`

mara: attaching condensed logs (excerpt):
```
[2026-03-18T12:05:02Z] kernel: select=cutlass_int8_tiled (tile=256)
[2026-03-18T12:05:05Z] cache: evict=LRU, entries_evicted=1342, kv_writebacks=0
[2026-03-18T12:05:08Z] prefetch: window=1024, issued=89, completions=75
[2026-03-18T12:05:10Z] perf: p99_latency_ms=312 -> 392 (int8)
```

zoe: interesting — prefetch completions < issued looks like prefetch throttling. int8 path may change memory access stride so prefetcher misses. also int8 usually reduces model size but changes packing/alignment which can fragment KV entries and raise eviction churn. can you `--dump-kv-entry-sizes` and check median entry size by slen?

perf-bot: auto-bench summary for run 2123: {"eu/h100/int8": {"p50":45, "p95":210, "p99":392, "hitrate":0.72}, "us/a100/int8": {"p50":40, "p95":195, "p99":310, "hitrate":0.80}, "eu/h100/fp16": {"p50":42, "p95":180, "p99":315, "hitrate":0.80}}

sanjay: that perf-bot table is helpful. H100 EU int8 p99 is worst and hitrate also lower. can you try eviction=2Q or LFU? 2Q often reduces churn when there are many medium-lived entries (slen mixing). also try prefetch=0 to see if prefetcher is making it worse.

mara: ran quick toggle tests:
- `eviction=2Q, prefetch=1024` -> hitrate 0.76, p99 355ms
- `eviction=2Q, prefetch=0` -> hitrate 0.79, p99 330ms (closer to us/a100)
- `eviction=LFU, prefetch=512` -> hitrate 0.78, p99 340ms
so disabling prefetch helped.

lee: that suggests prefetcher + kernel path contention was amplifying misses. disabling prefetch reduces in-flight fetches -> fewer evictions. but may increase cold-miss latency. how did p50/p95 behave?

mara: p50 roughly same, p95 improved a bit with 2Q+prefetch=0. cold-miss tail still present for slen 4096 but overall p99 improved.

zoe: hypothesis: int8 kernel increases per-token compute so per-token service time is longer, which increases KV cache lifetime overlap; meanwhile prefetcher issues a lot of outstanding fetches that fill cache and evict useful entries. with LRU you get worse thrash. 2Q reduces thrash. we should also check KV entry sizes by bucket. can someone run `bench trace --dump-kv-size --run 2123`?

mara: ran dump: median kv entry sizes: slen8:12KB, slen64:38KB, slen256:150KB, slen1024:560KB, slen4096:2.1MB. int8 reduced model param footprint but not per-entry activation size; packing + alignment gave ~8-12% size variance across runs which matters for high slen.

sanjay: thanks. next steps I propose:
1) full sweep across GPUs/regions: GPUs=[a100,h100], regions=[us,eu], quant=[fp16,int8], eviction=[LRU,2Q,LFU], prefetch=[0,256,512,1024], slen_buckets=[8,64,256,1024,4096]. collect p50/p95/p99, hitrate, kernel-path chosen.
2) add metric: outstanding-prefetches and kv-fill-rate to bench output.
3) run shorter A/B in prod-dedicated for EU-H100 disable prefetch for canary traffic.

lee: also check host->device PCIe vs NVLink saturation charts. if H100 nodes in EU have different interconnect config we might see higher transfer latencies under load.

zoe: I'll prepare an experiment matrix and a small script to parse perf-bot output into a heatmap (by slen vs p99). propose run start tomorrow 09:00 UTC, will need ~3h of cluster time per region.

mara: assigning: @zoe prepare matrix + dashboards, @sanjay coordinate runs across US/EU, @lee check kernel-selection logs & interconnect metrics, I'll run the bench and collect traces.

sanjay: ack. I'll also try a quick hybrid policy where prefetch window scales with slen (prefetch=min(256, slen/2)) to reduce unnecessary outstanding fetches for long sequences.

mara: perfect. if the data shows consistent improvement with 2Q+prefetch tuning we'll document a recommended default profile for int8 in eu-h100 and consider rollout. :thumbsup:

perf-bot: note: flagged run 2123 as "quality-regression-int8-eu-h100" for tracking ticket PROD-9472.

mara: thanks all — will post results in this thread when runs complete.
